Callout.Name: Tourists Lost on a Trail
Callout.Message: Family of four lost on a trail, phone at 4% battery.
Callout.Advisory: They can describe a waterfall and a fence.

Script.Line: There are four of us and two of them are children.
The phone is at four per cent. I am going to lose it.
We came off the trail where the sign was missing.

Lines.Approach: They have a waterfall and a fence and about four per cent of battery left.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
